name: Noachian-Nave
description: Whatever this world was, it finished. Gray plains run to a dead horizon, interrupted by impact-scarred wastelands and the glassed scars of some ancient catastrophe.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
There is money in uranium and salvageable alloys and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
